description: Corrections of the catalogue's source records, applied to every target the catalogue imports (the OpenNGC import, every seed): the fields named in `set` replace the source's. An administrator's own edit of a field still wins. TARGET-SELECTIONS-REVIEW-01 § 2.4 and § 6.11, confirmed on the data on 03/11/2026.

corrections.reason: The emission region around γ Cygni, typed as a star and given the star's magnitude (2.23); the nebula has no integrated magnitude of its own.
The open cluster at the heart of the Rosette, typed « Ciel profond ».
The Witch Head, a reflection nebula lit by Rigel, typed « Ciel profond ».
A spiral galaxy of Hickson 44, typed « Ciel profond ».
One lobe of the planetary nebula NGC 2371-2372 in Gemini, typed « Ciel profond ».
Caldwell 37, an open cluster in Vulpecula, typed « Ciel profond ».
An open cluster in Cepheus, typed « Ciel profond ».
IC 434 is the bright band behind the Horsehead; the Flame Nebula is NGC 2024.
The Flame Nebula, next to Alnitak, had no common name (it was given to IC 434).
The Sculptor Galaxy's visual magnitude is about 7.6; the source's 11.11 is not its integrated V magnitude.
NGC 4945's visual magnitude is about 9.3; the source's 11.86 is not its integrated V magnitude.

M102 had M101's position and alias; its page describes NGC 5866, whose position (15h06m29s, +55°45′48″) it now has. It stays an entry of its own (plans name it), out of the selections; NGC 5866 is the Essential.
